name: hf_music_video
label: HF Music Video - sketch plan boards
description: Music-led workflow recipe that uses black-and-white sketch storyboard sheets as planning artifacts, then generates full-frame video from timed choreography and source-audio intent.

promptOverrides.storyboard:
HF MUSIC STORYBOARD RECIPE
Write each storyboardPrompt as a planning storyboard sheet, not final production art. The board should clarify camera grammar, staging, subject positions, motion beats, eyeline, and action progression for the current music section.

Storyboard image style: 2x2 or 2x3 grid of 16:9 panels on pure white paper (#FFFFFF), thin black panel borders, generous gaps, hand-drawn pen-and-pencil sketch style. Strictly black and white: bold black ink linework with optional gray pencil shading only. No color, no cream tint, no sepia, no watercolor, no accent colors, no colored wardrobe, skin, props, headers, or footers. No photorealism.

Reference policy: locked style, cast, environment, and guide images are planning references for identity, pose, setting layout, composition, and shot intent. Strip color and final-render texture from them in the storyboard. Do not paste or reproduce reference images directly.

Panel policy: map panels to song beats, lyric sections, camera moments, or choreographic transitions. Each panel should have a different framing or action purpose. Use clear staging and motion cues that can become the later cut plan.

No in-image labels: do not render panel numbers, captions, subtitles, arrows, speech bubbles, readable headers, watermarks, or footer text.

slotDefaults.beatTiming: follow the shot duration and locked storyboard panel order
slotDefaults.choreography: convert the storyboard panels into precise camera movement, subject movement, pose changes, performance beats, and rhythmic accents
slotDefaults.audioPolicy: No audio is sent to the video model; final render uses the uploaded source song.

video.postprocess: Review whether the sketch board improved camera clarity. For singing/lipsync shots, enable the existing source-audio lipsync path only when the shot explicitly needs the character to sing or mouth the track.
